Values on this page come from tokens.json. Marketing (light) was measured on robinhood.com/us/en/. App dark was measured on the signed-out login page, body.is-dark-theme. Capsule Sans, Phonic and Martina Plantijn are not loaded here.

Sweepstakes banner uses the marketing lime. In app dark this falls back to the green accent.

Type

Buy shares at the IPO price.

Hero is Martina Plantijn 72/78, letter-spacing -1px, measured on the US marketing h1. The face is not embedded.

Trade crypto 24/7

Section titles are Phonic 40/48. Login title is Capsule Sans Display 21/500.

Components

Buttons

Sign up Log In Log in

Marketing pills are 44px tall, radius 36px, padding 0 32px. The app Log In button is a white pill, radius 44px, black label. The nav Log in is a lime outline.

Text field

Login fields are 36px tall, radius 4px, 1px border. The focused email field used a white border. Empty, error, and disabled states were not shown.
